qualification.package: Clean public wheel from the tagged source; both unprivileged image imports report 0.16.0 and load the FP8 sparse P·V module. Offline layers reuse the same immutable dependency images as 0.15.1, with no model payloads or SageAttention extension.
qualification.engine: The sageattention2 policy (SageAttention 2.2.0 SM120 dense edges plus FP8 sparse P·V) ran complete I2VA requests on one RTX PRO 6000 Server (resident FP8): denoising 6-14% shorter than FROST BF16 with FP16 sparse P·V, and no-reference flicker 0.97-1.02 and sharpness 0.96-1.01 of that baseline on four same-seed pairs. See the 0.16.0 release notes.
qualification.limits: SageAttention remains an explicit, separately installed SM120 extension; defaults are unchanged. Not a universal visual or sound-quality claim. Application capacity and lane declarations are separate.
